about.title: About Kyrgyzstan
about.section_header: A Land of Mountains, Traditions & Timeless Hospitality
about.section_body: From snow-capped peaks to vast valleys, Kyrgyzstan is a land of breathtaking landscapes, nomadic heritage, and deep-rooted traditions. It offers a unique blend of untouched nature and authentic cultural experiences.
about.heritage_desc: Experience authentic nomadic way of life.
about.culture_desc: Warm hospitality, traditional cuisine and crafts.
about.canyon_desc: Breathtaking mountains, lakes and endless horizons.
